highlights: [2.22.4] Fix: Same Bill Number allocation issue
[2.22.4] Fix: appLogger hash chain — hash advances optimistically, drain handler clears pending queue without re-writing (eliminates silent duplicate entries)
fullchange: [2.22.4] Fix: Duplicate bill number — save_exit now calls allocate() to verify the reserved number matches the actual billNo before consuming. Mismatch triggers release() instead of silently leaking the reservation. Edit-bill and edit-order modes excluded from this check.

[2.22.4] Fix: Update download button — replaced separate BrowserWindow modal (had frame, script loading, and IPC timing issues) with native dialog.showMessageBox. In-page modal code kept for future use.

[2.22.4] Fix: appLogger hash chain — hash advances after every write() regardless of backpressure (data is in Node's internal buffer, not lost). Drain handler only clears the pending-confirmation queue — no re-writing (eliminates silent duplicate entries from v2.22.3).
[2.22.4] Change: Theme & Auth cookie for Dev and Prod are now different
